title: Introduce stability shim for cross-region circuit coordinator and KV-drain idempotency hotfix
author: Ethan Caldwell
release_notes: Fix: mitigate transient islanded-region rejoin that caused duplicate KV-drain operations and brief SLO violations; add short-term stability shim for cross-region circuit coordinator; improved telemetry for post-failover analysis.
commits: fix(kv): make kv-drain idempotent by adding drain-token and last-drain-ms checks
feat(coordination): add ephemeral stability_shim to coordinator to chew off quick rejoin noise
chore(telemetry): emit circuit_coordinator.event and kv_drain.attempt metrics with tags
test(slo): add unit + integration test covering duplicate-drain and regional-rejoin windows
docs: update runbook entry for regional failover with new shim thresholds
description:
Motivation:

Production incident (SUP-9043) on 2026-02-15 surfaced a pattern where a regional control-plane flapping event produced a short burst of rejoin traffic that triggered the regional circuit coordinator to rapidly toggle ephemeral circuits. That flipping coincided with concurrent KV-drain attempts on replicas and caused duplicate drain operations (race + missing idempotency) leading to transient SLO blips for tail latency.

What this PR does (single string):

- Adds a short-lived "stability_shim" inside the cross-region Circuit Coordinator that detects high-frequency state churn for a specific tenant/route and introduces a micro-quarantine window (default 800ms) to absorb rejoin noise without triggering global circuit transitions. The shim is intentionally conservative and feature-gated.
- Makes KV drain idempotent by adding a drain-token + last-drain-ms guard in pkg/kv/drain.go. If a node reports the same drain-token within the last 5s the attempt is considered noop. This prevents duplicate side-effects (double snapshotting / double metrics).
- Emits new telemetry hooks: coordination.circuit_shim.{enter,exit,skipped} and kv_drain.{attempt,noop,success} with tenant and route tags to make incident postmortems faster.
- Adds unit tests and a small integration harness that simulates quick rejoin bursts and asserts no duplicate drain side-effects and that coordinator stays within expected SLO windows.
- Updates runbook with short-term mitigation and rollback instructions.

Design notes / rationale:

- The stability_shim is deliberately transient and conservative: it only suppresses coordinator-driven global state transitions when it detects >3 state flips within 1s for the same tenant/route. This reduces risk of masking real failures while addressing the noisy-rejoin pattern observed in SUP-9043.
- Idempotency for drain is a defensive fix: even if the coordinator eventually transitions, duplicate drain operations must be safe. The token approach is low-latency and backwards-compatible.
- Telemetry additions are lightweight counters and histograms; they are safe to ship to staging first (the feature flag defaults to on in staging).

Checklist:

- [x] Code compiles and unit tests pass locally
- [x] Added integration test for rapid rejoin scenario
- [x] Feature-gated shim behind coordinator.stability_shim.enabled and config thresholds
- [x] Runbook updated and pagers notified (SRE rotation)
- [x] Smoke-tested on staging for 24h before merge

Review conversation (excerpt integrated into description string):

Priya Menon: "This looks reasonable; please confirm how the shim behaves during prolonged outages (>=30s) so we don't delay necessary failover."

Ethan Caldwell (author): "Good call — shim is limited to absorbing micro-churn only and will not prevent transitions when the coordinator sees sustained error states or health probes fail; added explicit comment and a unit test that emulates sustained loss."
review_comments: Priya Menon: please ensure metrics include tenant_id and route to make postmortems manageable.
Lina Alvarez: change looks safe, please add a note on config rollout plan for Dedicated customers.
Marcus Chen: CI flaked once on telemetry; re-run passed — LGTM after author response.
ci_notes: CI initially failed on telemetry lint (style); fixed by renaming a metric var. All checks green after second run (unit, integration, lint, e2e-staging smoke).
post_merge_actions: Feature flag will be monitored on staging for 48h. Ops will roll to canary hosts in us-west-2 then eu-west-1. If we see >3 circuit_shim.enter events per minute for any tenant, revert the config patch. Runbook updated with rollback commands and dashboards linked.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: behavioral change in coordinator; guarded by feature flag, limited window, and idempotency ensures side-effects are safe.
notes_for_release_manager: Ship in next patch release. Include runbook link in release notes and ensure SRE rotation is aware of metric names. No DB migrations.
